title: Reciprocal twist and weighted fields give coefficient-one square-root exchange

statement.quantifiers: Finite E; nonzero multiaffine h(x)=sum_U f(U)x^U, f>=0 supported on ONE parity, h(z)!=0 whenever Re z_i>0. EVERY S,T in supported parity and EVERY a in D=S symmetric_difference T.
statement.assertion: sqrt(f(S)f(T)) <= sum_(j in D,j!=a) sqrt(f(S xor {a,j}) f(T xor {a,j})); optimal universal leading constant one. Zero endpoint cases immediate and S=T has no a. No homogeneity, determinant representation, genericity or log-concavity premise.
assumptions: Multiaffinity, constant parity, nonnegative coefficients and right-half-plane stability.
Signed real-stable upper-half-plane polynomial transfers only under explicit i-rotation as in source.

inputs: Exact stable coefficient family; common occupied core remains in coefficient data.
outputs: Aggregate exchange bound, support symmetric-exchange implication.
interface.precision: Exact all-size theorem; zeros handled by infimum limits.
costs: Computing coefficients, microscopic determinant energies, canonical paths and congestion remain separate services.
No FPRAS follows from exchange alone.

proof_mechanism: Twist all T variables by reciprocal; inversion preserves right half-plane and coefficients become f(T xor U).
Zero-specialize outside D using Hurwitz closure and nonzero constant f(T).
Set x_a=1,x_j=w_j z; parity makes degree |D|-1 odd with endpoint/neighbor identities.
Apply LA009 then inf_w(sum A_jw_j)(sum B_j/w_j)=(sum sqrt(A_jB_j))² including zero-support limits.
obstructions: Squaring gives square of sum, NOT already-refuted coefficient-one sum of squares.
Aggregate support exchange does not select low-energy microscopic exchanges or bound two-replica ratios.
Drop parity and endpoint reduction fails; unsigned upper-half-plane stability not inferred.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct microscopic determinant-weighted transitions and prove polynomial energy/congestion bounds rather than treating aggregate exchange as sampler.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
